description: This file contains test scripts for Git operations, specifically testing push behaviors and hook errors in a repository setup. It performs push commands with assertions on failure or success, and manipulates references for setup purposes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, incorporated here to check failure conditions related to pre-receive hook errors.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, used here to verify behavior when hooks are missing or errors occur.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Processes command output to a stable, human-readable format.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Saves expected output for comparison in tests.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files for equality.
